Tampa Bay Nekton Index (TBNI) outcome by bay segment and year

Source: R/anlz_fw_tbni.R
anlz_fw_tbni.Rd

Tampa Bay Nekton Index (TBNI) outcome by bay segment and year

Usage

anlz_fw_tbni(fimdata, from = c(32, 46))

Arguments

fimdata

data.frame of raw fisheries independent monitoring data, e.g. tbeptools::fimdata

from

numeric vector of length 2, the c(min, max) range of Segment_TBNI passed to util_outcome as its from argument. Defaults to c(32, 46), TBNI's own grade breakpoints. Pass c(0, 100) to revert to a plain linear rescale over the full score range with no clamping.

Value

A data.frame with columns bay_segment, yr, Segment_TBNI (the raw 0-100 score), Action (management action category from anlz_tbniave), and outcome (0-1, 1 = best)

Details

Uses anlz_tbniscr and anlz_tbniave to score each bay segment/year 0-100, then converts to a 0-1 outcome with util_outcome (type = "continuous"). With the default from = c(32, 46), matching TBNI's own grade breakpoints (On Alert below 32, Caution from 32 to 46, Stay the Course above 46), scores below 32 give an outcome of 0, scores above 46 give an outcome of 1, and scores in between are linearly rescaled.

Examples

anlz_fw_tbni(tbeptools::fimdata)
#> # A tibble: 112 × 5
#>    bay_segment    yr Segment_TBNI Action          outcome
#>    <chr>       <dbl>        <dbl> <fct>             <dbl>
#>  1 HB           1998           47 Stay the Course   1    
#>  2 HB           1999           47 Stay the Course   1    
#>  3 HB           2000           44 Caution           0.857
#>  4 HB           2001           44 Caution           0.857
#>  5 HB           2002           39 Caution           0.5  
#>  6 HB           2003           41 Caution           0.643
#>  7 HB           2004           41 Caution           0.643
#>  8 HB           2005           32 Caution           0    
#>  9 HB           2006           41 Caution           0.643
#> 10 HB           2007           42 Caution           0.714
#> # ℹ 102 more rows
